degree.text: Degree Awarded Doctor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objectives This program will enable you to be qualified personnel with advanced technology and engineering knowledge of safety & environmental science and related disciplines. It will help you to develop all-round morality, intellectuality and physical fitness in order to meet the needs of modern industrial development. Main Courses Engineering of Safety System, Risk Assessment, Environmental Monitoring Technology, Air pollution Control Engineering, Information Technology of Safety Engineering, Water Treatment Engineering, Environment Quality Appraisement, Safety monitoring, Solid Waste Treatment Engineering, Elementary Chinese (Oral Chinese, Intensive Chinese & Extensive Chinese), A Survey of China, Advanced Math, Physics, Fundamental Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Doctor Degree of Engineering. Career After graduation, you will be capable of working in the fields of design, research, monitoring, evaluation, supervising and management related with safety and environmental engineering.

duration.text: The Urban and Suburban Planning at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Undergraduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of Undergraduate school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Master's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
